lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhè cì qù nánfāng zěnme qù?
lines.english: How are you going to the south this time?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我坐火车去。火车票不贵。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuò huǒchē qù. Huǒchē piào bù guì.
lines.english: I'm taking the train. Train tickets aren't expensive.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Zuò huǒchē yào duō cháng shíjiān?
lines.english: How long does the train take?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 大概二十个小时。虽然长，但可以看风景。
lines.pinyin: Dàgài èrshí gè xiǎoshí. Suīrán cháng, dàn kěyǐ kàn fēngjǐng.
lines.english: About twenty hours. Although long, you can see the scenery.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ dài chī de le ma?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 带了。面包、水果、饮料都有。
lines.pinyin: Dài le. Miànbāo, shuǐguǒ, yǐnliào dōu yǒu.
lines.english: Yes. Bread, fruit, drinks - all there.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Can you sleep on the train?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 可以。我买了卧铺票，睡得很舒服。
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ. Wǒ mǎi le wòpù piào, shuì de hěn shūfu.
lines.english: Yes. I bought a sleeper ticket, sleep very comfortably.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 祝你一路平安，旅途愉快！
lines.pinyin: Zhù nǐ yīlù píng'ān, lǚtú yúkuài!
lines.english: Wishing you a safe journey and happy travels!
